comment: The two jacks under the BW and Scl knobs are the inputs the maker never named, so both carry blank tooltips. The partial jacks write straight into the faders, Pad2.cpp:181, so a cable and the faders cannot disagree. The random fill, Pad2.cpp:296-297, is fired by the Generate button and by the Rnd Trigger jack alike, and it writes the faders rather than replacing them behind the scenes, so the sound can be adjusted afterwards. The wavetable is built on a background thread, which is what lets every control be moved while the sound plays.
